name: RenderCache

test_list.description: A second metadata preparation with unchanged entries and width reuses cached per-entry rows.
Changed bounded content, viewport width, or presentation-tool state causes a miss rather than stale rows.
The LRU cache evicts least-recently-used rows and never reports resident memory above its configured budget or 32 MiB maximum.
Exact content snapshots remain collision-safe while a separate 1 MiB ceiling prevents retaining large transcript copies.
The cached and uncached paths produce identical visible cells and source metadata.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Borrowed view and presentation state for one screen pass.

inputs.name: cache
inputs.description: Caller-owned bounded cache retained across render calls.

output_description: Geometry and transcript rows prepared for the current screen pass, with cache accounting available to the caller.
